propositions: Operators need a reproducible report separating Git pack bytes, checkout logical bytes, checkout allocated bytes, and whole-clone footprint without conflating packing with checkout or filesystem slack.
The tracker-footprint command is explicit, opt-in, read-only, and never runs implicitly from writes, gates, reconciliation, or metrics.
Fresh-clone mode creates a temporary single-branch unfiltered clone to measure standalone footprint; default mode detects and labels shared object stores in linked worktrees.
The report identifies platform allocation unavailability as a structured value rather than fabricating zeros when st_blocks is unsupported.
Size is descriptive only; no threshold, verdict, alert, or nonzero exit is caused solely by a large measurement result.
Mounted linked-worktree mode distinguishes shared object databases from standalone clone cost.
